title: GDC Preflight Validation Results
description: Standardized contract for surfacing decoupled pre-provisioning hardware, software, and network readiness checks.

test_suite.description: The name of the test runner or suite generating this report (e.g., 'gdc-ansible-preflight').

execution_timestamp.description: RFC3339 timestamp of when the test suite completed execution.

overall_status.description: Aggregated status of the entire test suite. FAIL indicates at least one FATAL test failed.

total_duration_ms.description: Total execution time of the test suite in milliseconds.

results.description: Collection of individual test case executions.

test_name.description: Unique identifier or descriptive name for the individual test.

category.description: The domain of the validation check.

status.description: The outcome of the test execution.

severity.description: The impact of a test failure. FATAL means provisioning cannot proceed.

notes.description: Detailed output, error messages, or context regarding the test execution.

remediation_hint.description: Optional actionable advice for an operator to resolve a failure.

timestamp.description: RFC3339 timestamp of when the specific test was executed.

duration_ms.description: Execution time of the individual test in milliseconds.

meta.description: Optional arbitrary metadata associated with the test execution (e.g. resolved IPs, socket status).
